steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Who goes there?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Stop right there.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Do you know where you are, and exactly what that sword you're holding is?

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: It's a sword. The sword that I've been looking for.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Let us set aside the question for the time being who it is you are working for and how you made your way in here.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Hand over the sword. I'll take you to the Grandmaster.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: A fickle-minded, perfidious man like him does not deserve to keep this sword.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Impudence!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Grandmaster has defended Yumen's peace for a hundred years. How dare you speak ill of him?!

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: How pretentious. What do you even know? Out of my way!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I've arrested no small number of criminals, but you are the first one I've met to be so arrogant.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: Solemn on the outside, but self-centered on the inside. I've met plenty of men like you!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I see I have no choice but to get you to comply forcefully, then.

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: Try it.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It's over. You've lost.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: This isn't where we settle this.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: If you would leave, surely you would leave us with an explanation?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: I want answers, but you have none to give me.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: You let her get away.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: With her injuries, she won't get far.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Wei, your old bones don't seem to be much use here.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: My sincerest gratitude, Lin.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You are master of the Chi Xiao, yet you need someone to come to your rescue when your mortal enemies come attacking?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I do not remember having made such an enemy.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: A feint!

steps.name: Exotically Dressed Girl
steps.text: Hmph...!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're injured. Where can you run?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Watch out, Grandmaster!

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Grandmaster, what happened here?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: This is my fault.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The sword has been taken.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: General, the assassin could not be found within five miles of the inner city, and there are no signs of her receiving assistance from anyone.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: No one else was ambushed, and neither the inner city core nor the armory show signs of having been infiltrated.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: No signs, or has it been confirmed they have not been infiltrated?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: We... cannot say for sure at this moment...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: How could someone infiltrate the Yumen barracks and roam free... even after facing our four masters here.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Extraordinary.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I was too careless.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Do you have any clues regarding the identity of our assassin, Lord Wei?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Over the years, I've come across many who wanted my life, but I am alive and well nonetheless.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: All of them have either given up on the idea or perished long ago.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I am not acquainted with our friend tonight.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Zuo Le, any discoveries on your end?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It all happened too suddenly. I wasn't prepared, and I wasn't able to take the assassin in, as a result.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: I'm not asking why you were unable to capture the assassin. I'm asking you what you saw.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It was a young female assassin who infiltrated us and took the sword. She was hurt when she made her escape. Aside from that... I'm afraid I don't have anything.
A cup shatters, with the Lord Exorcist seizing all its fragments with his hand.
Even with the distinguished guest in attendance, at that moment, he finds himself unable to quell his anger, just as he wasn't able to control his shaking hand as he drew his bowstring earlier.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Now that it has come to this, talking about it will do us no good.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Send the order out. Seal the city gates immediately, and set up checkpoints between each district. Do not allow unnecessary travel between them.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: In addition, send the word to the entire city. At the Hour of Shen two days from now, Yumen will slow and adjust course. Have the masses make ready for this.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Zuo Le.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Capture the assassin, locate the Grandmaster's sword, and find the Shanhaizhong hiding in the city. Do all three without failure.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: You have three days. My personal troops are yours to command.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Keep this secret, and do not disturb the people.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Where's Lin?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: He left as soon as the soldiers came.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lin has no standing in the court, meaning he has no right to stand in attendance as you give your orders.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Is there anything I can assist with?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Seeing as the assassin is after your life, your safety should be the top priority.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Once this commotion calms, I will send a battalion to escort you back to Lungmen.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: I ask you to stay indoors for the next few days.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: May I ask what you mean by that?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Exactly what I said.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Yumen will take care of the rest.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Our foe this time is exceptionally skilled. Perhaps I should...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: I ask you to stay in the barracks and ensure the Grand Tutor's and Lord Wei's safety.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It is equally dangerous to allow the criminal to roam free in the city.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: This affair began because of the Feranmuts. Considering you are who you are, you should not get yourself involved.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: After all, the only ones who know your true identity are all here in the room.
The general's tone is hardly heavy, yet it fills the entire building with silence.
A sigh can be heard from one of its corners.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Very well...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Do you have any objections to this arrangement, Grand Tutor?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I trust your judgment, Lord Exorcist.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Execute these orders at once.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: Grandmaster, are you alright?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I don't believe there's anyone alive who could do him harm.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It seems you really believe in me...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: From the sound of it, you have heard already.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Let us set aside the issue of the soldiers outside the city for the time being. The defense of Yumen was part of your responsibilities to begin with. Considering this arrangement, Zuo Xuanliao clearly doesn't trust you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Naturally, I understand and empathize with General Zuo's position.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Which is why I have a few things I need you to help me with, over the next few days.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: This is highly unusual, and the foe we are up against is especially treacherous. I hope you'll lend Zuo Le a helping hand.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Given how he is, he may not be very receptive to me meddling with his affairs.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: In that case, it would seem now is not the time for us to resolve the matter between us.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You need not say any more. I know the score.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: With how little I have to do the next few days, I am hoping you will help me finish writing the last few chapters of the Book of Kung Fu as quickly as possible.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: It is my duty, as your student.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Record Keeper
steps.text: If there is nothing else, Grandmaster, I will take my leave. Please get some rest soon.
The man sighs, perhaps at the sight of the empty sword mount on the wall or something else.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: How many more will you drag into this game...?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Once a pure stream of water flows into a polluted lake, you can no longer scoop any clean water from it. Don't you understand that?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Even if you try to replace it, you will never find her in all the chaos.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Why torment yourself with all this?
The sound of the patrol's clanking armor can yet be heard from afar, with nothing but a deafening silence otherwise.
The night is deep. The clamorous night finally calms.
He lets out another long sigh.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Hmm?
How very brave of you.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: How could I have failed to realize that you were here as well?
Of course I am here too.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Are you going to stop me?
A skilled Go player making no skillful moves in an entire game. Your actions are really a bit too radical.
Oh... Or maybe it's because... your time is limited.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: If that's where we are going, you barely have any time left yourself.
Do you really think we can ignore everything just because that man sealed his self away in the sword?

spans.text: Do you really think we can ignore everything just because that man sealed his

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: I came here for the one. Why would I be concerned with only one-twelfth?

spans.text: Why would I be concerned with only one-

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: I could ask you. What makes you think that you can become him?

spans.text: I could ask you. What makes you think that

steps.text: I won't become him. I am no one but myself.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: He and I. We have a score to settle.
That grudge is yours and yours only.
We are not enemies.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: That's not for you to decide.
At the very least, at this point in time, we both have more important things to accomplish.
We won't be a hinderance to each other.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Is that a truce you are seeking?
It's in both our interests. You have no reason to refuse.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: You really are nothing like your brothers and sisters.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: I hope you'll show me something more interesting the next time we meet.

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: Miss! I heard you—

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Keep it down.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I thought I told you not to seek me out in broad daylight.

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: It's good to see all of you in one piece...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Any progress on your end?

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: The Yumen markets are open for the first time in years. There are too many wares and people flowing in and out. We have no leads yet.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: If it's not so convenient for us to look into this, let's have somebody else do it.

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: What do you mean...?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How many of the merchants at the markets here are locals, and how many are from Lungmen?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How many of the people behind us have missing paperwork at the L.G.D. or are in hock to us? Sift through them, and find someone who'd have an easier time than we would. It's not that hard.

steps.name: Lungmen Tourist?
steps.text: Daai Siu Ze, this... sounds like it could be against the rules.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do as I say.
Two weeks ago...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Feranmut followers?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You needn't know where the intel came from.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Out of all the enemies that Yan has faced in the past thousand years, no small number of them lurked in the shadows.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Yumen may rely on Lungmen for its supplies, but you shouldn't be responsible for security within their borders.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Yumen is an impenetrable shield, but there are pests hiding behind that shield. They need to be exterminated by others.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I want to send you there to take care of this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You can operate as a special L.G.D. commanding officer. On paper, you will be in charge of security while the two cities are connected, and you will have a certain level of support from me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I need you to run a thorough investigation into the dangerous elements hiding among Yumen's citizenry and ensure its smooth sailing. Should the need arise, you may resort to the most extreme measures.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Why me?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Because you are Lin Yühsia. Because you can take care of this.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I want you to do in Yumen what the Rat King did in Lungmen all those years ago.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Chief Wei... You didn't discuss this with my father before you came to me, did you?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Yühsia.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad? You didn't tell me you were coming.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You accepted Wei Yenwu's mission. I came take a look.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: So you've heard.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Investigating smugglers, eh?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I didn't want to trouble you.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Look at you, going through all the trouble to hide this from me. It's Wei Yenwu who you should be troubling.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You never considered turning this down?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Somebody has to maintain the peace here...

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Wei Yenwu has many a capable character under his wing. Why must you of all people clean up his mess?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Never mind. I could figure out what kind of excuses Wei is making even if I had to think with my tail.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You should know what's happened tonight.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: So that's why the soldiers locked the city gate.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: So much has happened in the span of a day. If this was really a coincidence, it would have to be a hell of a coincidence.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: The Chief of Lungmen finds himself the target of an assassination attempt, the Grandmaster has his sword taken, and an Imperial Astronomical Bureau Messenger was killed. Each of these would make the headlines on its own.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: And they all occurred within hours of each other. It's unimaginable what kind of forces are behind them.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: When Wei Yenwu came to you, did he explain how dangerous this was going to be?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: All I knew was this wasn't going to be a walk in the park.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Yumen is not Lungmen, and you are not me.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I know that well... I will deal with this carefully.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The agents I brought with me from Lungmen are all masters in their fields and have all followed you for years.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Plus, I know the world of jianghu... I've seen enough.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: If you know what it is you are doing, then I won't keep rambling.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I just hope this will be resolved quickly without delaying your trip to Victoria.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's just a study trip. I don't have to go...

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You've helped me and the L.G.D. take care of plenty of things the last few years... to the point you haven't been able to do what you truly wanted to do yourself.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I did all that of my own volition, and it was all for Lungmen.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: It's not your own choice if you haven't seen another path.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Sometimes I wonder if... perhaps, like Ch'en, you should—

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Dad! Are you hurt?! I'll get a doctor!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: It's been years since I've taxed my arms and legs so much. My bones are aching. Looks like taking walks in the park every day isn't quite enough exercise.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'll take you back to the general's estate.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: No need for that either. I'll find an inn nearby to stay the night.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Even getting to meet my old friends once is once aplenty, and I can't stand the atmosphere in that house tonight.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: My, what a coincidence.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I heard a commotion at the edge of the city earlier in the evening, and I figured something big must've happened. And now that I find you here, Mr. Lin, I'm sure something big must've happened.

spans.text: I heard a commotion at the edge of the city earlier in the evening, and I figured something big must've happened. And now that I find you here, Mr. Lin, I'm

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: So what you are saying is, an old rat like me might as well be a plague?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Of course not. I was only joking.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Yühsia, let me have a few words with Mr. Lee in private.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Please excuse me.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: From the looks of it, your search in Yumen hasn't been too successful?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Don't get me started. The man has been gone for well over a decade, I was never banking on finding him within a month.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But it doesn't matter how long it takes. We still have to look for him.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You are a carefree man. It's only when it concerns this old friend of yours that you burden yourself so much.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Maybe I owe him from a past life...

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Since you aren't in a hurry, may I hire Lee's Detective Agency for a job?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How could I refuse a job from Mr. Lin himself?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That gets me thinking though. Haven't I been taking on a few too many troublesome jobs lately?

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: It goes to show what a capable man you are. We'll say I owe you one, if you do this for me.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, with such a generous offer on the table, looks like I really have to think this over and see if I can manage it.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Heh, only a crafty fellow like you could manage this.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: One, two... nine, ten...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Urgh... All the names above me on the rankings look pretty tough...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Okay... Calm down... Just do your best...

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Why can't I leave the city? Two of my brothers just died out there...

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: The gate is closed. Please leave.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Hey, be reasonable, can't you—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You?

steps.name: Yumen Passerby
steps.text: Whoa, the Forte hunk with the golden mace got kicked right out of the arena.

steps.name: Yumen Passerby
steps.text: That Feline girl has won five straight matches now!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Phew—

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Hey. Ni hao. I watched all your matches today.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: You've got amazing kung fu. Want to come work for me and my escort association?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Escort association?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Not interested.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Don't be so quick to refuse. With your skills, I can give you a more than decent wage!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'm not planning on making a living with my fists. I have a degree in mechanical engineering, I'll have you know.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Mechanical what...?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Never mind that! That just means you're something of a scientist, right? Yeah, science! The escort association I'm talking about is a new kind of logistics company. Science graduates like you have a bright future with us.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Hey, don't just walk away. I'm serious.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: So, that just happened...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: It sounds you're going to have to wait till the lockdown is over before you can take your friends' belongings and news of their deaths back home to Shangshu.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I'm the one who brought them here. No matter how, I will bring them home.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Before I came to Yumen, I ran into Mr. Zheng in Shangshu by chance.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: He told me that when the day comes that no one needs kung fu to protect themselves, that's when we will finally have true peace.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Dad is right about that, but for now, I'm more fond of another saying. An eye for an eye.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I will find the one who did this.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What are you two doing here?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yühsia?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: The government official lady from earlier?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I thought you said you'd get to the bottom of this? How are you going to get to the bottom of anything now that we're on lockdown?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You two know each other?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: There's been a turn of events. Things are apparently trickier than I thought.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Then let me investigate with you!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I-I can help out, too...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's too dangerous. I can't drag outsiders—

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: W-What's that sound?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Drums from the outer city district?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Look! The beacons are lit on the city walls.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's the Wangfeng Festival, one of Yumen's traditions. It's a ceremony held every year at the beginning of spring, and it lasts three days.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The drums at the barracks are beaten for the citizens' benefit. Each beat tells them the city, the lands, and all Great Yan are safe.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: As for the signal fires on the city walls, they are lit to guide the soldiers who gave their lives on the battlefield home.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Home...
Catastrophes sweep across the country, barbarians terrorize the borderlands, and bandits stir up trouble...
The drums are beaten seventeen times, representing the trials and tribulations that befell Yumen the past year, both big and small.
This border city has crossed the country's northern regions for centuries, and its citizens are hardened by these disasters.
The great wind cannot extinguish the flames in the meadow, the men's eyes fix upon their homes through the night.
